verdict.rationale: Calendly's own webhook docs confirm that invitees can cancel and reschedule meetings. Events fire when meetings are "canceled by either the host or the invitee," and an invitee reschedule triggers both invitee.created and invitee.canceled. Calendar sync is documented, but only for checking conflicts before booking. Missing for 10: evidence that reschedule/cancel links appear in the invitee's confirmation, any enforcement of host policies (notice windows, cancellation rules), explicit evidence that connected calendars update on reschedule/cancel, and independent corroboration.
